decision.question: Compared with the source image, has the edited image been fully transformed into a drawing made from chalk, rather than only partially stylized toward that appearance?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the source-to-edit change makes the image as a whole read as a chalk-made drawing, with the requested transformation complete. Fail if the image remains substantially photographic or otherwise shows only a partial chalk-style conversion, even when some chalk-like texture or shading is evident. Unknown if either image is unavailable or the evidence is insufficient to judge the degree of transformation.
decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images to assess the extent and completeness of the requested chalk-drawing transformation; judge the overall result, not isolated chalk-like cues, and do not require a particular visual recipe.
